{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Envoy Loogg spoke today over the Caarite holonet. All seems to be going well. There is prosperity at home, and the alliances he had sought to forge are stronger than ever. As the galaxy divides itself, it is those who stay out of the conflict who will be strongest when the smoke clears.|Personal log of Celis Bol|<ref name="CA">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away}}</ref>}}
The '''Caarite holonet''' was a communications network.<ref name="CA" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the events depicted in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the [[Caarite]]<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Thurm Loogg]],<ref name="CA" /> the [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]] of the [[Metatheran Cartel]] trade alliance to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]],<ref name="LFCG" /> made a speech over the Caarite holonet in which he spoke of how the Cartel was prospering by not involving itself in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CA" /> a tumultuous conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Loogg's speech on the Caarite holonet was listened to by the Metatheran Cartel [[Technician/Legends|technician]] [[Celis Bol]].<ref name="CA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Caarite holonet was mentioned in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure by [[Morrie Mullins]] released in [[March]] [[2003]]. The adventure formed part of the [[Metatheran Caution trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign, a supplement to [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]].<ref name="CA" />
